emotionPlan.name: Huzurlu
emotionPlan.interpretation: design parameters, not a measurement of listener emotion

naturalDesign.description: instrumental-only foreground; synthetic ah/oh/hum voice omitted

pianoImprovisation.method: seeded chord-tone improvisation with four-bar hills and valleys

coreArrangement.name: six-stage motif-led arrangement with staggered, register-aware soloists and selective choral support

pianoGrandStaff.method: section-aware varied chord-tone solo with sparse, accented bass roots

songForm.sequence: GİRİŞ → ANA TEMA → GELİŞİM → DÖNÜŞ → DORUK → KAPANIŞ
songForm.description: Seed-specific motif: preview → statement → transformation → recognizable return → controlled crest → resolving coda.

transpositions.method: nearest chord tone in each bar, register-safe

refrain.identity: main-theme rhythm and contour recalled across peak/refrain sections
refrain.description: Refrains preserve the source motif and use a bounded transposition with chord-tone/register correction.

dynamicArc.restAndRecovery: two-bar phrase breaths, reduced development/transition density, sparse coda and final decay room
dynamicArc.interpretation: relative score velocity plan, not a measured loudness or validated fatigue score

variationMethods.development: selected interval inversion and rhythm change
variationMethods.climax: controlled contour expansion with sparse chorale answers
variationMethods.closing: sparse descending motif and tonic resolution

soloPlan.surprise: section-level solo change and sparse chorale response; no micro-note ornaments
soloPlan.foregroundDensity: one sustained note per bar for theme/return/coda; one per bar for cello; one foreground note per bar in all solo sections

vocalTrack.reason: ah / oh / hum voice samples removed from the V21 arrangement

celloPizzTrack.reason: short pizzicato cello removed; new foreground uses sustained arco cello

pianoHook.motif: seeded multi-contour melody with section-specific rhythmic density

harpConflictResolution.method: keep chord tones and avoid semitone collisions against simultaneous voices

tempoArc.method: smoothed section and phrase rubato with an explicit bar map

measureSync.checks: all event starts and durations are recalculated against the current bar and tempo map

performancePolish.method: legato solo line; phrase-end chord-safe reed turns; varied chord-tone bass contour and measure pickups

metricalRepair.legato: successive right-hand notes meet or overlap slightly; every note ends by the barline
metricalRepair.tempo: one barline tempo point per measure; adjacent change capped at 2 percent

stationRules.label: Ambient
stationRules.description: Beat-space events, tempo-map seconds, meter endpoint and notation timing are revalidated after every profile tempo clamp.

tempoSustain.description: Slower tempo than 60 BPM requests longer written note values; bar boundaries, next onsets, quarter-beat quantization and structural/harmonic checks limit or cancel extensions. One-shot samples can decay earlier.
